sources.observed: Living Standard last updated 16 September 2026, retrieved 17 September 2026
sources.finding: Canvas image-element sources use the format-defined default for animation-disabled use; only absent a default do they use the first animation frame.

sources.observed: PNG Third Edition; sections 4.9.1–4.9.2 and 11.2.3 inspected
sources.finding: IDAT is the static image. With first fcTL after IDAT, that static image is outside the animation; fdAT contains animation frame data. Removing animation chunks leaves the ordinary PNG static image.
Both image-element and Blob ImageBitmap paths specify the same default-image/first-frame rule. Changing API alone is not evidence of a decoder fix.
APNG implementer explains hidden poster/default data is skipped and first visible frame is returned to canvas. This explains the observed symptom but is not a current-build certification.
Decoder author describes first-frame-only APNG as first non-hidden frame and says canvas does not receive the hidden fallback. This is historical evidence only.

sources.kind: current upstream decoder tests, mutable HEAD
sources.finding: Ihdr50ActlIdatFctl30Fdat checks decoder frame zero as the first fdAT animation frame, distinct from full static IDAT. Supports the decoder distinction; it is not itself a canvas conformance result.
